name: Robo360
summary: 面向三维物理世界建模的全视角机器人操作数据集，以密集多视角记录不同材料和光学性质物体的操作过程，支持动态神经场与多视角策略研究。
summaryEn: An omnispective robotic manipulation dataset with dense multiview coverage and objects spanning varied material and optical properties for 3D physical-world modeling.
scale: Dense 360-degree multiview manipulation sequences across diverse objects and materials
scaleZh: 覆盖多种物体和材料的密集 360 度多视角操作序列
organizations: University of Texas at Austin and collaborators
organizationsZh: 得克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校及合作团队
license: Project repository is MIT; dataset-specific terms require verification
licenseZh: 项目仓库采用 MIT；数据专用条款待核验
access: Official project repository and paper entry available; dataset terms require verification
accessZh: 提供官方项目仓库和论文入口；数据条款待核验
wmNote: 密集同步视角和材料多样性特别适合动态三维表征及物理属性建模，但数据访问条件需要在使用前确认。
wmNoteEn: Dense synchronized views and material diversity are valuable for dynamic 3D representations and physical-property modeling, while access terms should be confirmed before use.

evidence.sourceTitle: [2312.06686] Robo360: A 3D Omnispective Multi-Material Robotic Manipulation Dataset
evidence.statement: Dense-view robot manipulation recordings are explicitly used for dynamic neural representations and multi-view policy learning.
